11. Printable One-Page Quick Revision Sheets & Formula Compendium

            
All high-yield formulas, algorithms, 2D matrices, colour models, audio/image/video size equations, and mobile generations on one page.

          

          
        


        

          

            
Sheet 1: Display Systems, Frame Buffer & Scan Conversion

            
    
              
  • Random Scan (2017 Q.131 & 2023 Q.20): Vector / Calligraphic / Stroke-writing display; draws lines like a pencil.
    • 
              
  • Persistence (2021 Q.180): Time for phosphor light to decay to $1/10	ext{th}$ ($10\%$) of original intensity.
    • 
              
  • Frame Buffer Size: $	ext{Bytes} = (W 	imes H 	imes b) / 8$; Simultaneous Colors $= 2^b$.
    • 
              
  • Bresenham Line (2017 Q.164): Integer math only! $p_0 = 2\Delta y - \Delta x$; if $p_k < 0 	o p_{k+1} = p_k + 2\Delta y$; if $p_k \ge 0 	o p_{k+1} = p_k + 2\Delta y - 2\Delta x$.
    • 
              
  • Circle Symmetry (2021 Q.81): 8-way symmetry $(\pm x, \pm y), (\pm y, \pm x)$; Midpoint $p_0 = 5/4 - r pprox 1 - r$.
    • 
              
  • Cohen-Sutherland Clipping (2023 Q.28): 4-bit `TBRL` outcodes; Inside $= 0000$; $(C_1 	ext{ AND } C_2) 
eq 0 	o$ Reject; Intersecting $	o$ Partially visible.
    • 
            

          


          

            
Sheet 2: 2D Transformations, Projections & Colour Models

            
    
              
  • 2D Translation: $x' = x + t_x, \quad y' = y + t_y$.
    • 
              
  • 2D Scaling (2021 Q.182): $x' = x \cdot S_x, \quad y' = y \cdot S_y$.
    • 
              
  • 2D CCW Rotation (2021 Q.87): $x' = x\cos	heta - y\sin	heta, \quad y' = x\sin	heta + y\cos	heta$.
    • 
              
  • Pivot Rotation about $(x_p, y_p)$: $T(x_p, y_p) \cdot R(	heta) \cdot T(-x_p, -y_p)$.
    • 
              
  • RGB $\leftrightarrow$ CMY (2021 Q.181): $(C, M, Y) = (1 - R, 1 - G, 1 - B)$ (or $255 - R$ in 8-bit). RGB = Additive (Monitors); CMYK = Subtractive (Printers).
    • 
              
  • Bezier Curve (2023 Q.25): $N$ control points $\implies$ polynomial degree $N - 1$; passes through $P_0$ and $P_{N-1}$.
    • 
            

          


          

            
Sheet 3: Audio, Image, Video Formulas & Compression

            
    
              
  • Nyquist Sampling Theorem: $f_s \ge 2 	imes f_{\max}$ (CD Audio: $20	ext{ kHz} 	o 44.1	ext{ kHz}$; Quantization levels $= 2^b$).
    • 
              
  • Audio Bitrate & Size: $	ext{Bitrate} = f_s 	imes b 	imes C$; $	ext{Size (Bytes)} = f_s 	imes (b/8) 	imes C 	imes t$ (CD Stereo $= 1411.2	ext{ kbps} pprox 10	ext{ MB/min}$).
    • 
              
  • Video Size: $	ext{Size (Bytes)} = W 	imes H 	imes (b/8) 	imes 	ext{FPS} 	imes t$ (Cinema $= 24	ext{ fps}$, PAL $= 25	ext{ fps}$, NTSC $= 30	ext{ fps}$).
    • 
              
  • Formats (PYQs): JPEG = Lossy DCT (2021 Q.82); PNG = Lossless DEFLATE + Alpha (2025 Q.48); GIF = Lossless LZW (256 colors); MP3 = Lossy Audio Layer-3 (2021 Q.184); MIDI = Symbolic notes.
    • 
              
  • RLE & Huffman: RLE encodes runs `(count, symbol)`; Huffman assigns shortest prefix-free codes to highest-frequency symbols.
    • 
            

          


          

            
Sheet 4: Mobile Computing, GSM, 1G–5G & Security

            
    
              
  • GSM Subsystems (2021 Q.179): 1. RSS/BSS (BTS + BSC), 2. NSS (MSC + HLR [permanent] + VLR [roaming] + AuC + EIR [IMEI]), 3. OSS.
    • 
              
  • Speed Order (2021 Q.88): $\mathbf{	ext{GSM (2G)} < 	ext{GPRS (2.5G)} < 	ext{EDGE (2.75G)} < 	ext{LTE (4G)} < 	ext{5G NR}}$.
    • 
              
  • Multiplexing: FDMA (frequency bands), TDMA (time slots — 2023 Q.44), CDMA (PN Walsh codes + Soft Handoff — 2021 Q.65). Cluster size $N = i^2 + ij + j^2$.
    • 
              
  • Mobile IP (2023 Q.19): Home Agent (HA) tunnels packets to the Foreign Agent (FA) router on the visited network (Care-of-Address).
    • 
              
  • Wireless & Security: Wi-Fi MIMO (2025 Q.9), Bluetooth Piconet ($1	ext{ Master} + 7	ext{ Slaves}$), GPS ($\ge 4$ satellites), Bluejacking (spam) vs. Bluesnarfing (data theft), WPA3 (SAE).
    •

Local Setup & Zero-Config Vercel / Netlify Deployment Instructions

          
# Option 1: Run Locally on Laptop or Android Browser
1. Download `dsssb_cg_multimedia_mobile_hub.html` (or unzip `dsssb_cg_multimedia_mobile_hub_deployable.zip`).
2. Open `index.html` in Chrome, Edge, Firefox, or Safari — zero backend or API keys required.

# Option 2: Deploy to Vercel in 30 Seconds
1. Extract `dsssb_cg_multimedia_mobile_hub_deployable.zip` into a folder.
2. Run `npx vercel --prod` (or drag and drop the folder onto https://vercel.com/new or https://app.netlify.com/drop).
